description: A label, such as a garment label or a radio frequency tag, used for identifying a product.

attachmentDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value, for the attachment of this product label.

barcodeId.description: The barcode identifier of this product label.

brandName.description: The brand name, expressed as text, on this product label.

categoryCode.description: The code specifying the category of this product label.

identifier.description: An identifier of this product label.

includedAssertion.description: A sustainability assertion included on this product label.

layoutTypeCode.description: The code specifying the layout type of this product label.

name.description: The name, expressed as a text, of this product label.

seriesEndId.description: The identifier of the end of a series of product labels.

seriesStartId.description: The identifier of the start of a series of product labels.

sizeCode.description: The code specifying the size of this product label.

tagTypeCode.description: The code specifying the type of tag for this product label.
